description: This file contains the implementation of the CosmosGrainStorage class for Orleans, which manages grain state persistence using Azure Cosmos DB. It includes methods for reading, writing, and clearing grain state, as well as initialization and resource management logic. The class also implements lifecycle participation and logging.

classes.name: CosmosGrainStorage
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IGrainStorage and ILifecycleParticipant for managing grain state in Cosmos DB.

classes.name: CosmosStorageFactory
classes.description: A static factory class for creating instances of CosmosGrainStorage.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads the state of a grain from Cosmos DB asynchronously.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Writes the state of a grain to Cosmos DB asynchronously.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Clears the state of a grain in Cosmos DB asynchronously.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the storage to the silo lifecycle for initialization.

methods.name: GetKeyString
methods.description: Generates a sanitized key string for a grain ID.

methods.name: BuildPartitionKey
methods.description: Builds the partition key for a grain asynchronously.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the Cosmos DB client and resources.

methods.name: InitializeCosmosClient
methods.description: Creates and initializes the Cosmos DB client.

methods.name: TryCreateResources
methods.description: Creates Cosmos DB database and container resources if they do not exist.

methods.name: TryDeleteDatabase
methods.description: Deletes the Cosmos DB database if it exists.

methods.name: ResetGrainState
methods.description: Resets the grain state to default values.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of a grain state object.
